audit.future_runtime_command: docker compose --project-name motionly-local-audit --env-file <protected-local-env> --file infra/docker-compose.gpu.yml --file infra/docker-compose.dev.yml --file infra/docker-compose.local-audit.yml --profile local-audit
audit.namespace_scope: Only Compose resources created under the motionly-local-audit project name may be inspected or removed by later audit stages.

required_before_external_actions: Explicit non-production provider and publishing account identifiers.
An allowed visibility policy limited to private or unlisted artifacts.
Remote-artifact cleanup rules with an accountable owner.
A per-run spend ceiling approved for the audit.

local_audit.teardown_policy: Only project-scoped audit-owned resources may be removed; global down -v and volume pruning are forbidden.

live_effects_gate.model_boundary: ModelGateway.invoke before budget reservation and adapter invocation
live_effects_gate.publishing_boundary: execute_publish_job before OAuth refresh, signed download, and publish

required_markers: python -m ruff check app tests scripts

services.name: volume-permissions
feature_ownership: isolated media and model-cache volume ownership
services.startup_predicate: The one-shot initializer exits successfully after creating and chowning the shared media and model-cache paths.

verification.smoke_action: Inspect one-shot completion and shared-volume ownership inside the isolated Compose project.
verification.cleanup_responsibility: Remove only resources whose Compose project name is motionly-local-audit after evidence capture.

services.name: postgres
services.startup_predicate: PostgreSQL reports healthy through pg_isready.

verification.smoke_action: Run the Compose-declared pg_isready check against the isolated database.
verification.log_pattern: database system is ready to accept connections
verification.cleanup_responsibility: Remove only the isolated project database volume during teardown.

services.name: temporal-postgres
services.startup_predicate: Temporal PostgreSQL reports healthy through pg_isready.

verification.smoke_action: Run the Compose-declared pg_isready check against the isolated Temporal database.
verification.log_pattern: database system is ready to accept connections
verification.cleanup_responsibility: Remove only the isolated Temporal database volume during teardown.

services.name: redis
feature_ownership: BullMQ transport, idempotency, and cache state
services.startup_predicate: Redis reports healthy with authenticated redis-cli ping.

verification.smoke_action: Run the Compose-declared authenticated Redis ping inside the isolated project.
verification.cleanup_responsibility: Remove only the isolated Redis data volume during teardown.

services.name: temporal-db-init
services.startup_predicate: The Temporal database initialization job completes successfully after Temporal PostgreSQL is healthy.

verification.smoke_action: Confirm the one-shot Temporal database initializer exits successfully.
verification.cleanup_responsibility: The isolated Temporal database volume is removed only after captured audit evidence is complete.

services.name: temporal-schema
services.startup_predicate: The Temporal schema job completes successfully after database initialization.

verification.smoke_action: Confirm the schema bootstrap job exits successfully and emits its completion evidence.
verification.cleanup_responsibility: The isolated Temporal database volume is removed only after captured audit evidence is complete.

services.name: temporal
feature_ownership: self-hosted TLS Temporal workflow control plane
services.startup_predicate: The TLS Temporal cluster health command succeeds after schema setup.

verification.smoke_action: Run the Compose-declared TLS Temporal operator health command.
verification.cleanup_responsibility: Remove only the isolated Temporal control-plane resources during teardown.

services.name: temporal-namespace
services.startup_predicate: The namespace bootstrap job completes successfully after Temporal reports healthy.

verification.smoke_action: Confirm namespace bootstrap completion and query the isolated namespace metadata.
verification.cleanup_responsibility: Remove only the isolated Temporal control-plane resources during teardown.

services.name: supabase-auth
services.startup_predicate: The authentication service starts after application PostgreSQL reports healthy.

verification.smoke_action: Issue an isolated fixture-user authentication request through the private service path.
verification.cleanup_responsibility: Delete fixture identities and remove only isolated Supabase volumes during teardown.

services.name: supabase-rest
services.startup_predicate: The REST service starts after application PostgreSQL reports healthy.

verification.smoke_action: Issue a read-only isolated database REST request through the private service path.
verification.cleanup_responsibility: Remove only isolated Supabase volumes during teardown.

services.name: supabase-storage
services.startup_predicate: The storage service starts after application PostgreSQL reports healthy.

verification.smoke_action: Create, read, and delete a fixture object in an isolated test bucket.
verification.cleanup_responsibility: Delete fixture objects and remove only the isolated storage volume during teardown.

services.name: supabase-gateway
feature_ownership: private Supabase auth, REST, and storage gateway
services.startup_predicate: The gateway starts after the three private Supabase components have started.

verification.smoke_action: Verify the gateway routes isolated auth, REST, and storage fixture requests.
verification.cleanup_responsibility: Remove only isolated Supabase resources after fixture cleanup.

services.name: api
services.startup_predicate: The API starts after isolated volume initialization, Redis health, and PostgreSQL health.

verification.smoke_action: Call live and ready health routes, then compare the served OpenAPI shape to the checked-in contract.
verification.cleanup_responsibility: Delete isolated fixture workspaces and remove only project-scoped state during teardown.

external_side_effects.preflight: Provider and publishing flows remain blocked until the audit runtime preflight is explicitly satisfied.
